name: bench-midday-trail
js: (()=>{const app=window.__CITY_APP;if(!document.body.classList.contains("hud-minimized"))document.getElementById("btn-toggle-hud").click();app.teleportTo(-7100,-527,0);app.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[-7100,3,-527],look:[-591,40,141],fov:50});})();(async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));await sleep(3000);let n=0;const t=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{(function f(){n++;if(performance.now()-t<5000)requestAnimationFrame(f);else res()})()});console.log("[bench] midday-trail "+((performance.now()-t)/n).toFixed(2)+" ms")})()
